transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been feeling extremely overwhelmed, down, and anxious lately following a stressful life event. I really feel like I'm struggling to cope with things right now.
I'm so sorry to hear you're going through this. Could you tell me a little more about what that stressful life event was and when it happened?
I'm not quite ready to talk about the specific details of what happened just yet. But it occurred about four months ago, and things have been really difficult ever since.
I completely respect your privacy. Since that event, have you been experiencing any intrusive memories, nightmares, or flashbacks about what happened?
No, I haven't been experiencing any nightmares or flashbacks about what happened. I don't really get those kinds of intrusive memories either.
Since you mentioned feeling down, have you also noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in the activities you normally enjoy?
I'm not really sure, I haven't noticed that specifically. Mostly, I just feel very down and overwhelmed by everything right now.
Is your anxiety and worry mostly focused on the stressful event and its aftermath, or do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different everyday areas of your life?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about whether my worry is spreading to other everyday things, I just know I feel constantly anxious and overwhelmed right now.
Before this stressful event occurred four months ago, would you say you generally felt well, or have you struggled with similar feelings of anxiety and low mood in the past?

I generally felt fine before everything happened four months ago. I'm not sure if I've ever struggled with these kinds of feelings in the past, as it really seems to have all started with this recent event.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns or appetite since this event occurred? Also, have you been feeling constantly exhausted or lacking in energy?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite since then. I'm also not quite sure about my energy levels, as I've just been feeling so overwhelmed by everything else.
Have you been experiencing any feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or difficulty concentrating since this event occurred?
I haven't really experienced those specific feelings of worthlessness or guilt. I'm also not quite sure about my concentration, since I've just been feeling so overwhelmed lately.
